notes: Checks run from the repo root. Give a check a non-empty 'diffCommand' when its plain 'command' already fails on the default branch: the gate runs 'diffCommand' instead, with $MYSPEC_BASE_REF exported as the merge base with the default branch. Scope the command to that range and guard it against an empty file set, e.g. files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR $MYSPEC_BASE_REF -- '*.ts'); [ -z "$files" ] || npx eslint $files

checks.name: Lint
checks.description: Linter — replace with your project's lint command (e.g., 'npm run lint', 'pnpm lint', 'ruff check .')

checks.name: TypeCheck
checks.description: Type checking — replace with your project's type-check command (e.g., 'npx tsc --noEmit', 'pnpm typecheck')

checks.name: Test
checks.description: Test suite — replace with your project's test command (e.g., 'npm test', 'pnpm test', 'pytest')
